summary: Adapts how often each matrix is orthogonalized by estimating Newton-Schulz difficulty from layer geometry, spending Muon computation where it matters and reducing unnecessary matrix-multiply cost elsewhere.

summary: Uses linear associative memory as a tractable factual-recall model to compare one-step recovery rates for Muon, SGD, and Newton, characterizing when spectral optimizers recover overcomplete associations faster.

summary: Places Muon inside the Lion-K family and proves that decoupled weight decay makes it implicitly optimize under spectral-norm constraints on weight matrices.

summary: Uses convergence bounds for LMO-based optimizers, including normalized SGD, signSGD/Adam proxies, and Muon, to derive scaling rules for batch size and training horizon beyond model-size-only transfer.

summary: Uses Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization theory to modify Muon so updates preserve heavier-tailed spectra instead of over-flattening noise directions, improving LLM pretraining and image-classification performance in experiments.

summary: Interprets AdamW, Muon, and related methods as steepest descent under mean-normalized matrix operator norms, deriving row/column-normalized updates for width-stable hyperparameter transfer.
source_title: On the Width Scaling of Neural Optimizers Under Matrix Operator Norms I: Row/Column Normalization and Hyperparameter Transfer

summary: Analyzes Muon with and without Nesterov momentum and weight decay, proves weight-decay-induced boundedness, and derives how momentum and decay govern critical-batch-size scaling.

summary: Identifies post-polar row/column imbalance after practical Newton-Schulz Muon steps and adds one normalization step to improve blockwise descent without changing Muon's core orthogonalized-momentum design.
source_title: MUON+: Towards More Effective Muon via One Additional Normalization Step for LLM Pre-training

summary: Extends maximal-update-parameterization ideas to spectral optimizers by deriving conditions for feature-learning hyperparameter transfer across Shampoo, Muon, and related matrix methods.
source_title: Extending $μ$P: Spectral Conditions for Feature Learning Across Optimizers

summary: Combines zeroth-order finite-difference gradient estimation with subspace projection and Muon-style orthogonalization, reducing query variance while exploiting low-rank update structure in memory-efficient fine-tuning.
source_title: Powering Up Zeroth-Order Training via Subspace Gradient Orthogonalization

summary: Integrates Muon orthogonalized momentum with Adam-type noise adaptation through a norm-based adaptive stepsize, including a diagonal NAMO-D variant for additional stochastic stability.
source_title: Adam Improves Muon: Adaptive Moment Estimation with Orthogonalized Momentum

summary: Shows momentum steepest-descent methods such as Muon, Signum, and MomentumGD follow approximate norm-specific steepest-descent trajectories and converge toward KKT points of corresponding max-margin problems.
source_title: The Implicit Bias of Adam and Muon on Smooth Homogeneous Neural Networks

summary: Adds spectral guidance and mode-wise RSAV step control to Muon for physics-informed neural networks and operators, tempering unit-singular-value steps in stiff multi-scale scientific-learning losses.
source_title: Muon with Spectral Guidance: Efficient Optimization for Scientific Machine Learning

summary: Finds random update masking can regularize adaptive optimizers through curvature-dependent smoothing, then introduces momentum-aligned gradient masking as a dense-optimizer alternative that outperforms Adam/Muon in reported LLM pretraining.
source_title: On Surprising Effectiveness of Masking Updates in Adaptive Optimizers

summary: Keeps Muon's near-isometric orthogonalized direction but restores magnitude control through global RMS calibration and energy-based trust-region clipping to reduce step-size sensitivity and high-energy bursts.
source_title: TrasMuon: Trust-Region Adaptive Scaling for Orthogonalized Momentum Optimizers

summary: Uses simple strongly convex quadratic examples to show local one-step proxies and worst-case polar-error bounds miss key Muon behavior, motivating a dynamical view of spectral optimizer trajectories.
source_title: Insights on Muon from Simple Quadratics

summary: Characterizes mini-batch stochastic steepest descent under entry-wise and Schatten-p norms, showing how batch size, momentum, and variance reduction shape max-margin implicit bias for SignSGD- and Muon-like methods.
source_title: The Implicit Bias of Steepest Descent with Mini-batch Stochastic Gradient

summary: Decomposes Shampoo updates into an adapted Muon-like spectral step and shows its stochastic/trajectory adaptation explains why Shampoo can be more token-efficient than plain Muon, paralleling Adam versus Signum.
source_title: Clarifying Shampoo: Adapting Spectral Descent to Stochasticity and the Parameter Trajectory

summary: Builds adaptive operator-norm matrix online-learning algorithms by smoothing nuclear-norm potentials, yielding Pion/Leon-style methods with regret guarantees and nonsmooth nonconvex optimization rates.
source_title: Adaptive Matrix Online Learning through Smoothing with Guarantees for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization

summary: Introduces two-sided low-rank synchronization for Adam-family distributed training, communicating a compact U^T G V core to reduce bandwidth and memory relative to one-sided low-rank approaches.
source_title: From $O(mn)$ to $O(r^2)$: Two-Sided Low-Rank Communication for Adam in Distributed Training with Memory Efficiency

summary: Explains empirical gains of Lion, Muon, and other sign-based optimizers through heavy-tailed gradient noise, giving generalized noise conditions under which sign updates outperform variance-adaptive methods.
source_title: Sign-Based Optimizers Are Effective Under Heavy-Tailed Noise

summary: Decomposes AdaGrad into variance adaptation and scale-invariant update factors, using that split to bridge Adam-style vector adaptivity with Muon-style matrix spectral optimization.
source_title: Decoupling Variance and Scale-Invariant Updates in Adaptive Gradient Descent for Unified Vector and Matrix Optimization

summary: Analyzes Muon/SpecGD dynamics in LoRA-style matrix factorization, showing LoRA product singular values grow nearly uniformly even when orthogonalization is applied separately to the low-rank factors.
source_title: Uniform Spectral Growth and Convergence of Muon in LoRA-Style Matrix Factorization

summary: Derives warm-up-then-decay schedules for norm-constrained optimizers such as Muon and Lion from a generalized smoothness assumption where curvature falls with suboptimality, replacing heuristic warm-up with adaptive scheduling theory.
source_title: Where Does Warm-Up Come From? Adaptive Scheduling for Norm-Constrained Optimizers

summary: Studies Muon in a softmax linear associative-memory model with hierarchical frequency structure, showing spectral updates reduce frequency-dependent learning imbalance that slows gradient descent.
source_title: Muon in Associative Memory Learning: Training Dynamics and Scaling Laws

summary: Introduces logarithmic-time schedules for AdamW momentum and weight decay, letting gradient-memory horizons grow with training time and using damping to stabilize improved language-model scaling.
source_title: Logarithmic-time Schedules for Scaling Language Models with Momentum

summary: Provides an asynchronous, load-balanced framework for distributed matrix optimizers such as Shampoo, Muon, and SOAP, reconciling holistic matrix updates with tensor sharding in Megatron-style training.
source_title: Canzona: A Unified, Asynchronous, and Load-Balanced Framework for Distributed Matrix-based Optimizers

summary: Views Muon as the p=0 endpoint of U Sigma^p V^T spectral transformations and evaluates intermediate RMS/spectral variants to clarify how Muon relates to Adam-style adaptivity.
source_title: Delving into Muon and Beyond: Deep Analysis and Extensions

summary: Adds low-rank quasi-second-order information to first-order spectral descent through innovation-augmented polar decomposition, suppressing high-variance subspaces while preserving signal-dominated directions with little overhead.
source_title: PRISM: Structured Optimization via Anisotropic Spectral Shaping

summary: Generalizes gradient-noise-scale batch-size adaptation to signSGD/Signum and spectral-descent/Muon geometries, replacing Euclidean SGD assumptions with norm-matched stochastic noise estimates.
source_title: Adaptive Batch Sizes Using Non-Euclidean Gradient Noise Scales for Stochastic Sign and Spectral Descent

summary: Combines Lion-style sign momentum with approximate Newton-Schulz orthogonalization and a final entrywise sign step, approximating steepest descent over intersected spectral and l-infinity constraints.
source_title: OLion: Approaching the Hadamard Ideal by Intersecting Spectral and $\ell_{\infty}$ Implicit Biases

summary: Identifies persistent spike-tail anisotropy in LLM gradients and proposes spike-aware spectral suppression so dominant low-rank directions do not throttle tail learning, stability, and downstream quality.
source_title: Spectra: Rethinking Optimizers for LLMs Under Spectral Anisotropy

summary: Generalizes layer-wise Muon by treating network gradients as structured higher-order tensors and orthonormalizing across tensor modes, with convergence arguments and LLM pretraining experiments.
source_title: TEON: Tensorized Orthonormalization Beyond Layer-Wise Muon for Large Language Model Pre-Training

summary: Uses anisotropic phase retrieval as a model problem to show spectral gradient updates can avoid misalignment caused by dominant covariance directions that distract ordinary gradient descent.
source_title: Spectral Gradient Descent Mitigates Anisotropy-Driven Misalignment: A Case Study in Phase Retrieval

summary: Revisits manifold optimization for LLMs by projecting momentum onto tangent spaces and constraining updates on rotational oblique manifolds, seeking less memory/compute than AdamW while preserving curvature structure better than Muon.
source_title: Mano: Restriking Manifold Optimization for LLM Training

summary: Accelerates matrix square roots, inverse roots, and orthogonalization used by Shampoo/Muon through adaptive polynomial fitting plus randomized iterative sketching, avoiding eigendecomposition while improving GPU efficiency.
source_title: PRISM: Distribution-free Adaptive Computation of Matrix Functions for Accelerating Neural Network Training

summary: Combines Fisher-structured adaptivity with Muon-style momentum orthogonalization so update spectra retain curvature information instead of being forced into strict isotropic singular values.
source_title: FISMO: Fisher-Structured Momentum-Orthogonalized Optimizer

summary: Extends norm-constrained LMO optimizers such as spectral descent and Muon to manifold constraints with a single-loop method: choose a norm-induced Riemannian steepest direction and project back to the manifold.
source_title: Manifold constrained steepest descent

summary: Provides a simpler direct analysis of Muon for nonconvex optimization, improving convergence-rate guarantees without relying on restrictive assumptions about the orthogonalized update rule.
source_title: Improved Convergence Rates of Muon Optimizer for Nonconvex Optimization

summary: Analyzes practical Muon with finite Newton-Schulz orthogonalization, proving it matches ideal SVD-polar Muon convergence up to a constant that improves doubly exponentially with the number of NS steps.
source_title: Convergence of Muon with Newton-Schulz

summary: Compresses Muon momentum to four bits with grid quantization while preserving its top singular subspace and two-dimensional outlier structure, retaining accuracy with lower training memory.
source_title: Achieving low-bit Muon through subspace preservation and grid quantization

summary: Runs blockwise orthogonalization locally on most tensor-parallel steps and periodically performs a full Muon step, recovering near-AdamW throughput with an 8 percent gain over full Muon at 8B scale.
source_title: MuonBP: Faster Muon via Block-Periodic Orthogonalization

summary: Extends error feedback and bidirectional compression to non-Euclidean LMO optimizers, giving distributed Muon rigorous convergence guarantees and large communication savings.
source_title: Error Feedback for Muon and Friends

summary: Corrects the bias that makes naive local-Muon FedAvg fail, proving convergence with approximate LMOs and showing more Newton-Schulz accuracy can improve the federated rate.
source_title: FedMuon: Federated Learning with Bias-corrected LMO-based Optimization

summary: Links Muon's advantage to associative-memory parameters and heavy-tailed data, showing its more isotropic updates learn rare tail classes more evenly than Adam.
source_title: Muon Outperforms Adam in Tail-End Associative Memory Learning

summary: Optimizes LoRA adapters directly on a fixed-rank manifold with a parametrization-independent Riemannian generalization of Muon, paired with geometry-aware initialization and efficient autodiff.
source_title: LoRA meets Riemannion: Muon Optimizer for Parametrization-independent Low-Rank Adapters

summary: Runs rigorously tuned pretraining comparisons across model and data scales, finding Muon among the strongest methods but showing matrix-optimizer speedups shrink as scale grows.
source_title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them

summary: Shows spectral-gradient methods learn principal components at balanced rates on imbalanced data, explaining early and persistent generalization gains of practical Muon and Shampoo variants.
source_title: How Muon's Spectral Design Benefits Generalization: A Study on Imbalanced Data

summary: Models practical approximate orthogonalization as an additive LMO error and quantifies how finite Newton-Schulz and related inexact updates affect Muon convergence beyond exact-polar idealizations.
source_title: Beyond the Ideal: Analyzing the Inexact Muon Update

summary: Introduces Muon-NSR and Muon-VS, applying variance-adaptive normalization to momentum before orthogonalization to combine Adam-like stochastic robustness with Muon matrix geometry.
source_title: Variance-Adaptive Muon: Accelerating LLM Pretraining with NSR-Modulated and Variance-Scaled Momentum

summary: Studies simplified Muon in matrix factorization and linear-transformer in-context learning, giving end-to-end explanations of how spectral orthogonalization acts as useful preconditioning.
source_title: Preconditioning Benefits of Spectral Orthogonalization in Muon

summary: Collapses iterative Newton-Schulz orthogonalization into an iteration-free polynomial formulation by analyzing matrix-power contributions, reducing repeated high-dimensional matmul overhead in Muon/Stiefel settings.
source_title: IFNSO: Iteration-Free Newton-Schulz Orthogonalization

summary: Constrains both module weights and updates on a spectral sphere, aligning Muon-style update control with muP-like activation stability so weights cannot drift while updates remain norm-controlled.
source_title: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere

summary: Studies how to maintain muP spectral conditions throughout training with matrix optimizers such as Muon, aiming to preserve width-independent dynamics and hyperparameter transfer in practical runs.
source_title: Towards a Principled Muon under $μ\mathsf{P}$: Ensuring Spectral Conditions throughout Training

summary: Adds momentum variance reduction to the Gluon framework, giving one theory path that covers Muon, Scion, and other LMO optimizers and proves faster stochastic convergence than vanilla momentum.
source_title: Muon is Provably Faster with Momentum Variance Reduction

summary: Injects Hessian-corrected momentum into arbitrary-norm LMO optimizers such as Muon, Scion, and Gluon, using second-order information to improve rates beyond standard stochastic momentum bounds.
source_title: Better LMO-based Momentum Methods with Second-Order Information

summary: Constructs Muon-like optimizers from duals of Ky-Fan norms and their Frobenius/l-infinity combinations, yielding Fanions, F-Muon, and S-Muon families that interpolate matrix-update geometries.
source_title: The Ky Fan Norms and Beyond: Dual Norms and Combinations for Matrix Optimization

summary: Studies learning-rate and weight-decay scaling for matrix-preconditioned optimizers such as Shampoo, SOAP, and Muon, using hyperparameter transfer to make gains consistent across Llama model sizes.
source_title: Hyperparameter Transfer Enables Consistent Gains of Matrix-Preconditioned Optimizers Across Scales

summary: Preconditions the matrix before Newton-Schulz orthogonalization so Muon reaches useful polar accuracy with fewer matrix multiplications, making the overhead of acceleration nearly negligible.
source_title: Turbo-Muon: Accelerating Orthogonality-Based Optimization with Pre-Conditioning

summary: Derives a layer-wise diagnostic comparing gradient nuclear/Frobenius ratio with activation stable rank to predict when a Muon-style spectral step should beat a Euclidean gradient step.
source_title: When do spectral gradient updates help in deep learning?

summary: Unifies steepest descent, quasi-Newton, and adaptive methods through preconditioned matrix norms, then combines Muon's spectral geometry with Adam-style preconditioning in MuAdam and MuAdam-SANIA.
source_title: Preconditioned Norms: A Unified Framework for Steepest Descent, Quasi-Newton and Adaptive Methods

summary: Combines Muon orthogonalization with neuron-wise normalization and second-order statistics, targeting better scalability and efficiency by jointly leveraging Adam-like adaptivity and Muon matrix geometry.
source_title: NorMuon: Making Muon more efficient and scalable

summary: Adds adaptive clipping to differentially private Adam fine-tuning for localizable LLMs, improving the privacy-utility trade-off when task-specific models must be fine-tuned under privacy constraints.
source_title: DP-Adam-AC: Privacy-preserving Fine-Tuning of Localizable Language Models Using Adam Optimization with Adaptive Clipping

summary: Augments Adam with deterministic state-space exploration through alternating minimization/maximization phases, aiming to escape local minima rather than settling at the first basin visited.
source_title: Explore the Loss space with Hill-ADAM

summary: Extends Muon to decentralized graph optimization with gradient tracking for client heterogeneity and proves heavy-tail complexity matching centralized tolerance dependence.
source_title: DeMuon: A Decentralized Muon for Matrix Optimization over Graphs

summary: Combines Adam coordinate adaptivity with column-normalized updates, addressing Adam's low-rank/spectrally poor update structure while retaining per-coordinate variance scaling for faster LLM training.
source_title: Conda: Column-Normalized Adam for Training Large Language Models Faster

summary: Proposes a simpler parameter-free AdaGrad variant with convergence guarantees, removing manual learning-rate tuning while preserving AdaGrad-like rates in convex optimization.
source_title: Towards Simple and Provable Parameter-Free Adaptive Gradient Methods

summary: Proposes a parameter-free Adam variant with convergence guarantees that match Adam-style rates without assuming preselected learning-rate conditions, reducing manual tuning burden.
source_title: Towards Simple and Provable Parameter-Free Adaptive Gradient Methods

summary: Uses one- and two-batch momentum variance reduction to obtain horizon-free anytime guarantees for Muon, including an optimal stochastic nonconvex rate for Muon-MVR2.
source_title: On the Convergence of Muon and Beyond

summary: Exploits low-rank gradient structure to reduce orthogonalization cost, deriving low-rank MSGD and Muon variants with convergence theory and stronger large-model pretraining results.
source_title: Low-rank Orthogonalization for Large-scale Matrix Optimization with Applications to Foundation Model Training

summary: Recasts Shampoo/SOAP second-moment estimation as KL-divergence covariance estimation rather than Frobenius fitting, producing KL preconditioners that reduce Adam grafting or Adam-in-eigenbasis overhead.
source_title: Understanding and Improving Shampoo and SOAP via Kullback-Leibler Minimization

summary: Learns a compact perturbation strategy for zeroth-order LLM fine-tuning, training the optimizer once per foundation model and reusing it across downstream tasks to beat hand-designed ZO baselines.
source_title: Learning a Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine-Tuning LLMs

summary: Uses row-wise gradient normalization for state-free LLM training to reduce optimizer-state overhead while stabilizing matrix updates.
Applies element-wise second-moment scaling to Muon's orthogonalized directions, with sign-stabilized momentum and RMS-aligned rescaling to combine variance adaptivity with stable matrix geometry.
source_title: AdaMuon: Adaptive Muon Optimizer

summary: Finds column-wise gradient normalization plus last-layer momentum are sufficient minimalist changes to SGD for competitive LLM pretraining, matching Adam with much lower optimizer-state memory.
source_title: Memory-Efficient LLM Pretraining via Minimalist Optimizer Design

summary: Stabilizes Shampoo-style whitening by combining historical eigenbases with instantaneous normalization and shape-aware scaling, reducing divergence from stale inverse caches and improving wall-clock efficiency.
source_title: A Stable Whitening Optimizer for Efficient Neural Network Training

summary: Derives convergence rates for Muon and conditions under which matrix structure and low-rank Hessians let it outperform gradient descent.
source_title: On the Convergence Analysis of Muon

summary: Unifies matrix-aware preconditioned optimizers and introduces polar-decomposition update rules that explain links among Adam/Shampoo/Muon-style methods while improving convergence in reported experiments.
source_title: PolarGrad: A Class of Matrix-Gradient Optimizers from a Unifying Preconditioning Perspective

summary: Derives adaptive minimax-optimal matrix-sign iterations using only matrix multiplications and shows their bfloat16 integration can improve Muon validation loss over fixed Newton-Schulz alternatives.
source_title: The Polar Express: Optimal Matrix Sign Methods and Their Application to the Muon Algorithm

summary: Bridges theory and practice for LMO-based optimizers by generalizing Muon and Scion into a layer-wise framework with better memory efficiency, hyperparameter transfer, and LLM training performance.
source_title: Gluon: Making Muon & Scion Great Again! (Bridging Theory and Practice of LMO-based Optimizers for LLMs)

summary: Replaces Muon's dense Newton-Schulz orthogonalization with distributed amortized power iteration plus error feedback, enabling low-rank orthonormalized updates compatible with sharded LLM training.
source_title: Dion: Distributed Orthonormalized Updates

summary: Splits matrix-gradient subspaces between SOAP and Muon: it applies richer adaptive preconditioning to leading eigendirections and cheaper Muon-style updates to the remaining space for memory-efficient LLM training.
source_title: COSMOS: A Hybrid Adaptive Optimizer for Memory-Efficient Training of LLMs

summary: Scales Muon to larger LLM training by adding weight decay and per-parameter update-scale adjustment, reporting about 2x compute efficiency over AdamW under compute-optimal scaling and releasing the Moonlight recipe.
source_title: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training

summary: Introduces stochastic LMO-over-norm-ball optimizers for unconstrained deep learning, choosing norms that improve memory efficiency and hyperparameter transfer while giving nanoGPT speedups.
source_title: Training Deep Learning Models with Norm-Constrained LMOs

summary: Defines Muon as SGD/Nesterov momentum followed by Newton-Schulz orthogonalization of 2D hidden-layer updates, usually paired with AdamW for embeddings, heads, and non-matrix parameters.
source_title: Muon: An optimizer for hidden layers in neural networks

summary: Designs an optimizer specifically for deep fine-tuning converged models, using temporal gradient orthogonalization and assumptions about pretrained weights to regularize task adaptation beyond generic SGD/Adam.
source_title: PROFIT: A Specialized Optimizer for Deep Fine Tuning

summary: Adds a one-line cautious mask to momentum optimizers, preserving Adam-style Lyapunov convergence while empirically improving transformer training for C-AdamW, C-Lion, and related variants.
source_title: Cautious Optimizers: Improving Training with One Line of Code

summary: Brings variance-reduction ideas into large-model optimization by correcting adaptive/sign optimizer updates with gradient-difference signals, producing MARS variants that improve GPT-style training efficiency.
source_title: MARS: Unleashing the Power of Variance Reduction for Training Large Models

summary: Combines Subset-Norm step sharing, which reduces AdaGrad memory from O(d) to O(sqrt(d)), with Subspace-Momentum to lower optimizer-state cost while retaining convergence guarantees.
source_title: Lean and Mean Adaptive Optimization via Subset-Norm and Subspace-Momentum with Convergence Guarantees

summary: Modifies Adam so it converges at the optimal O(1/sqrt(T)) rate for any beta2 without bounded-gradient-noise assumptions, addressing Adam non-convergence while keeping adaptive-gradient practicality.
source_title: ADOPT: Modified Adam Can Converge with Any $β_2$ with the Optimal Rate

summary: Compresses optimizer states and activations into FP8 training through dynamic range expansion and related memory techniques, reducing memory footprint beyond FP8 linear-layer-only frameworks.
source_title: COAT: Compressing Optimizer states and Activation for Memory-Efficient FP8 Training

summary: Performs Adam-style adaptivity in changing low-dimensional projected subspaces, using projection-aware state updates and generalized error feedback to lower memory while still exploring full parameter space.
source_title: LDAdam: Adaptive Optimization from Low-Dimensional Gradient Statistics

summary: Shows Shampoo with half-power preconditioning is equivalent to Adafactor in Shampoo's eigenbasis, then stabilizes and simplifies Shampoo by combining it with Adam-style moment updates.
source_title: SOAP: Improving and Stabilizing Shampoo using Adam

summary: Adds a second, slower EMA of older gradients to AdamW-style momentum so the optimizer can use both recent directions and longer-term gradient memory, improving token efficiency.
source_title: The AdEMAMix Optimizer: Better, Faster, Older

summary: Cuts Adam memory by replacing most per-parameter second-moment learning rates with block-level rates chosen from Hessian-structure principles, retaining AdamW-like performance at about half memory.
source_title: Adam-mini: Use Fewer Learning Rates To Gain More

summary: Removes explicit learning-rate schedules by using schedule-free momentum/iterate-averaging theory, matching scheduled training performance without knowing the stopping step in advance.
source_title: The Road Less Scheduled

summary: Compresses gradients before feeding them into Adam states and uses compressed error feedback, reducing optimizer-state memory while preserving convergence guarantees.
source_title: MicroAdam: Accurate Adaptive Optimization with Low Space Overhead and Provable Convergence

summary: Interprets Adam as a diagonal empirical-Fisher natural-gradient method, identifies approximation flaws in standard Adam, and proposes corrections to momentum, bias correction, and epsilon handling.
source_title: FAdam: Adam is a natural gradient optimizer using diagonal empirical Fisher information

summary: Builds an auto-switchable preconditioner from stepwise gradient differences, using Hessian-related diagonal information to choose between adaptive and non-adaptive behavior during training.
source_title: AGD: an Auto-switchable Optimizer using Stepwise Gradient Difference for Preconditioning Matrix

summary: Adds adaptive learning rates to low-memory full-parameter LLM fine-tuning, keeping LOMO-style memory savings while closing much of the convergence gap to AdamW.
source_title: AdaLomo: Low-memory Optimization with Adaptive Learning Rate

summary: Combines AdamW, NAdam, and AdaBelief ideas by adding Nesterov momentum and precise step-size adjustment without extra hyperparameters, improving language-model and vision training baselines.
source_title: AdaPlus: Integrating Nesterov Momentum and Precise Stepsize Adjustment on AdamW Basis

summary: Benchmarks Continual Resilient optimization as a robust all-in-one first-order optimizer, emphasizing smooth convergence, low tuning burden, and broad applicability across machine-learning tasks.
source_title: CoRe Optimizer: An All-in-One Solution for Machine Learning

summary: Augments Adam with a memory buffer of critical momentum terms that intentionally overshoot narrow minima, encouraging exploration toward flatter basins and better generalization.
source_title: Promoting Exploration in Memory-Augmented Adam using Critical Momenta

summary: Uses confidence-guided memory-efficient second-moment estimation to reduce instability in Adafactor-like optimizers, aiming for Adam/LAMB quality with much lower auxiliary memory.
source_title: CAME: Confidence-guided Adaptive Memory Efficient Optimization

summary: Fuses gradient computation and parameter updates so full-parameter LLM fine-tuning can run under limited GPU memory, avoiding the optimizer-state cost of AdamW-style training.
source_title: Full Parameter Fine-tuning for Large Language Models with Limited Resources

summary: Improves D-Adaptation by estimating the distance-to-solution parameter needed for optimal learning rates, yielding a parameter-free optimizer that matches tuned methods across many tasks.
source_title: Prodigy: An Expeditiously Adaptive Parameter-Free Learner

summary: Recasts SAM sharpness as an explicit weighted regularization term, deriving generalization bounds and improving or matching standard optimizers on benchmark datasets.
source_title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization Revisited: Weighted Sharpness as a Regularization Term

summary: Introduces Distance-over-Weighted-Gradients, a parameter-free optimizer that adapts to smooth and nonsmooth convex problems using a distance-weighted gradient accumulator.
source_title: DoWG Unleashed: An Efficient Universal Parameter-Free Gradient Descent Method

summary: Uses a lightweight diagonal Hessian estimate as a stochastic second-order preconditioner with clipping, reducing language-model pretraining cost relative to Adam-family methods.
source_title: Sophia: A Scalable Stochastic Second-order Optimizer for Language Model Pre-training

summary: Provides a unified Adam-type framework covering Adam, NAdam, AMSGrad, AdaBound, AdaFom, and Adan through a general second-moment form with nonconvex stochastic convergence analysis.
source_title: UAdam: Unified Adam-Type Algorithmic Framework for Non-Convex Stochastic Optimization

summary: Wraps any first-order optimizer with low-dimensional second-order corrections by splitting the objective into orthogonal subspaces, using curvature where useful and the base optimizer elsewhere.
source_title: FOSI: Hybrid First and Second Order Optimization

summary: Discovers a memory-efficient sign-momentum optimizer through symbolic program search, keeping only momentum state and using update signs rather than Adam-style second moments.
source_title: Symbolic Discovery of Optimization Algorithms

summary: Sets SGD step sizes dynamically from distance-to-initial-point and gradient norms, removing the learning-rate hyperparameter while matching tuned SGD on vision and language transfer tasks.
source_title: DoG is SGD's Best Friend: A Parameter-Free Dynamic Step Size Schedule

summary: Automatically estimates the learning-rate scale for SGD/Adam/AdaGrad variants without line searches or extra gradients, matching hand-tuned rates across diverse convex and ML experiments.
source_title: Learning-Rate-Free Learning by D-Adaptation

summary: Meta-trains a neural-network optimizer at large scale across many tasks, producing a versatile learned optimizer that transfers with little tuning and exhibits non-hand-designed update behavior.
source_title: VeLO: Training Versatile Learned Optimizers by Scaling Up

summary: Adds model-oriented adaptive learning-rate decay and weight decay to Adam-style optimization, improving BERT/T5 pretraining speed while using less slot-variable memory than AdamW.
source_title: Amos: An Adam-style Optimizer with Adaptive Weight Decay towards Model-Oriented Scale

summary: Corrects each iteration's gradient norm using adaptive history so SGD/momentum-style optimizers maintain representative update magnitudes and improve CNN convergence.
source_title: AdaNorm: Adaptive Gradient Norm Correction based Optimizer for CNNs

summary: Derives an adaptive Nesterov momentum estimator that avoids extra extrapolation gradients and estimates first/second moments for faster, robust deep-model training.
source_title: Adan: Adaptive Nesterov Momentum Algorithm for Faster Optimizing Deep Models

summary: Modifies AdaGrad's monotonically shrinking denominator so the effective learning rate can both grow and shrink, preserving similar convergence rates while reducing tuning sensitivity.
source_title: Grad-GradaGrad? A Non-Monotone Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Method
